# Tasks Document

Document version: v2

Dependency order: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6. Task 1 adds the visual e2e suite and captures the before screenshots on the base frontend; task 2 swaps the token file and base stylesheet in behind a temporary bridge (D1); task 3 adds the shared UI module and restyles the shell; tasks 4 and 5 restyle the views, and task 5 removes the bridge and adds the scan test; task 6 captures the after set and runs the gate. Each task leaves `npm run build:dashboard` passing and every existing vitest and worktree e2e suite green; the frontend has no type check (`./tsconfig.json:20`). Planned verifier spend: four (tasks 2 and 3 create brand-new modules, so they route structural-red to high risk; tasks 4 and 5 exceed the line rule); tasks 1 and 6 are verification-only and implementer-only, still reviewed; no task touches an agent-rules sensitive path.

## Reference — T1 scan rules

Copied from the design-phase prototype `/tmp/scratchpad/sdd/dashboard-visual-refresh/probe/scan/scan.cjs` (scratch, see Scope notes; 83 hits outside the theme module at base, no false positive). Task 5 ports them to TypeScript unchanged.

```js
['hex', /(?<![&\w])#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{3,4})\b/g],
['colour-fn', /\b(?:rgba?|hsla?|oklch)\(/g],
['color-mix-literal', /color-mix\([^)]*?(?:#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|\b(?:rgba?|hsla?|oklch)\()/g],
['palette-class', /(?<![\w-])(?:[a-z-]+:)*(?:text|bg|border|ring|outline|fill|stroke|from|to|via|divide|placeholder|decoration|accent|caret|shadow)-(?:white|black|(?:slate|gray|zinc|neutral|stone|red|orange|amber|yellow|lime|green|emerald|teal|cyan|sky|blue|indigo|violet|purple|fuchsia|pink|rose)-\d{2,3})(?:\/\d+)?(?![\w-])/g],
['var-fallback-literal', /var\(--[\w-]+\s*,\s*(?:#|rgba?\(|hsla?\(|[a-z]+\))/g],
['arbitrary-length', /(?<![\w-])(?:[a-z-]+:)*[a-z-]+-\[-?\d*\.?\d+(?:px|rem|em|vh|vw|%)\]/g],
['dark-variant', /(?<![\w-])dark:[\w-]/g],
// inline length: a line whose style={{ ... }} text matches /\d(?:px|rem)\b/
```

## Decisions taken in this document

- D1 — Bridge in task 2: the legacy colour names stay as aliases, the dark variant line stays and the colour-namespace clear waits until task 5; options were renaming every reference in task 2 or the bridge; chosen because the views are rewritten in tasks 3-5 anyway, so each site changes once.
- D2 — The fourteen bare radius sites and the one large-shadow site move in task 2; options were leaving them to the view tasks; chosen because the namespace clears void them silently the moment the token file lands.
- D3 — The scan test lands in task 5, after the sweep; options were landing it first or in task 2; chosen because a red scan in an earlier task would keep the suite red across tasks, and the design bars allowlist entries.
- D4 — Textareas take the text-input recipe; options were a separate textarea kind or leaving them; chosen because Requirement 4.1 groups text inputs into one kind and the design names no textarea.
- D5 — The width-cap test finds the wrapper as the only child of the main element; options were a new test id; chosen because Requirement 6.2 freezes the test-id set.
- D6 — The one arbitrary minimum width becomes the 28-step spacing utility (112 px, the same 7 rem); options were a new token; chosen because a spacing step already gives the value.
- D7 — The cross-view check searches only inside the main element; chosen because the sidebar is the same element on every view and would pass trivially.
- D8 — Screenshots and the evidence file are written on the feature branch under this spec's directory and relocated at the merge gate; chosen because agent-rules require that for verification-only artifacts.
- D9 — The seed helper adds one resolved deferral; options were relying on the copied fixture alone; chosen so a success pill can appear on two views (closed spec, resolved deferral) for the cross-view check.
- D10 — The sideways-scroll test sits in the frame task as a regression guard; chosen because a width that fails on base is a frame fix and belongs to that task.
- D11 — The CI chip map on the run page, which the design's tone table omits, maps green to success, pending to warning, red to danger and unreadable to neutral; options were leaving it on its own classes; chosen because its four status colours already carry exactly those meanings and Requirement 4.2 puts every status pill on the six tones.

- Frontend type checking stays absent; each frontend task proves the build with the vite build instead.
- RE-DECIDED: Requirement 2.3 — the scan test's red proof runs on the task-5 tree (at least the chart hex and the arbitrary width), not on base, because tasks 2-4 already remove most base hits (D3). The base hit list stays recorded by the design prototype.
- The scan rules beyond the seven prototype regexes are written by the task 5 implementer from design C7 T1; no prototype exists for them.
- The prototype files under `/tmp/scratchpad/sdd/dashboard-visual-refresh/probe/` may not survive a reboot; the Reference section holds the regexes so task 5 does not depend on them.
